question: Can the exact P5J positive PSF bundle be compiled into finite, positive, no-ringing discrete kernels at a high-fidelity reference sampling rate while exposing the inadequacy of naive 4000-dpi direct sampling?

compiler.gaussian_cell_integration: normal CDF over each pixel cell

allowed_after_pass: retain a high-fidelity 16000-dpi reference kernel for synthetic/reference simulation
open a separately frozen reference-render-then-downsample versus cheap target-resolution LOD experiment
forbidden: claim that direct 4000-dpi kernel sampling is faithful when its measured-interval error exceeds the warning threshold
fit kernels to photographs, AO6 outputs or preference choices
apply the reference kernel as a production operator
claim calibrated stock, roll, process, scanner, colour or product response
change the physical-domain order or introduce negative/ringing taps to improve MTF fit

branch_rule.reference_pass_direct_warning: Retain reference kernel and open an explicit LOD/downsample compiler; direct target-resolution use remains closed.
branch_rule.reference_pass_direct_ok: Retain reference kernel and open photographic severe/value gates only under a separately frozen target-scale contract.
branch_rule.reference_fail: Close discrete compilation and retain the analytic P5J bundle only.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic high-sampling conformance for a manufacturer-MTF-derived positive PSF; not target-resolution, photographic, calibrated or product evidence.
